resources.string: Sign in to continue to Orbit
For self-hosted Orbit. Leave as %1$s unless your admin gave you another address.
Your session expired. Sign in again.
Enter an HTTPS instance address without credentials, query or fragment.
Couldn\'t reach the server — check the instance URL and your network connection.
Could not access secure storage. Sign in again.
The server ran into an error. Try again in a moment.
Sign-in failed — the server\'s answer wasn\'t an Orbit sign-in. Check the instance URL.
New to Orbit? Continue with Google to create an account.
Couldn\'t sign in with Google. Continue with Google to try again, or sign in with your password.
No browser on this device can open Google sign-in. Install or enable a browser, or sign in with your password.
Google sign-in was interrupted before it finished. Continue with Google to try again.
That Google sign-in didn\'t match the one this app started, so it wasn\'t used. Continue with Google again.
This Orbit account is disabled. Ask an administrator to enable it again.
This Orbit server has no accounts yet. Create its first administrator in a browser at /setup, with an email and a password.
Google sign-in is turned off on this server. Sign in with your email and password, or ask an administrator to turn it on.
Too many Google sign-ins from your network. Wait a minute, then continue with Google again.
Too many Google sign-ins are in progress on this Orbit server. Wait a few minutes, then continue with Google again, or sign in with your password.
Orbit couldn\'t start Google sign-in from this app. Continue with Google to try again; if it keeps failing, sign in with your password.
That Google sign-in expired before it finished. Continue with Google to try again.
Google sign-in was cancelled. Continue with Google to try again, or sign in with your password.
Orbit couldn\'t confirm your sign-in with Google. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, ask an administrator to check this server\'s Google sign-in settings.
Your Google account\'s email address isn\'t verified. Verify it with Google, then continue with Google again.
This Google sign-in expired or was already used. Continue with Google to try again.
More than one Orbit account uses this email address, differing only in capital letters. Ask an administrator to remove the duplicate, or sign in with your password.
The Orbit account with this email address is connected to a different Google account. Continue with that Google account, or sign in with your password.
Google can\'t confirm that this email address is still yours. Sign in with your password, then connect Google on your profile page in Orbit on the web.
No Orbit account uses this Google account yet. Ask an administrator to create one for your email address, then continue with Google again.
Debug builds don’t receive release updates.
To install updates, allow Orbit to install unknown apps (Allow from this source), then come back.
Waiting for Android to install the update…
Couldn’t reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
GitHub’s limit for update checks was reached. Try again after %1$s.
Couldn’t check for updates. Try again later.
The download didn’t finish. Try again.
The download didn’t match its published SHA-256 and was deleted.
The download isn’t signed with this app’s certificate and was deleted.
